summary: Frontend testing of QMRT Simulation Lab Structure Overlays feature completed successfully. All 7 features tested and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Structure Overlays toggle section displays correctly with 4 checkboxes (Strain Nodes, Clusters, Particle Nodes, Vortices)
All toggle checkboxes control visibility of respective overlay types on heatmaps
Hover tooltip shows type-specific details (STRAIN: E, σ | CLUSTER: Φ, n | PARTICLE: type, m | VORTEX: ω, χ)
Click on structure opens inspector panel with full properties
Inspector panel shows Position, Energy Density, Gradient, Stability fields for strain nodes
Inspector panel shows Position, Coherence, Members, Size fields for clusters
Close button (data-testid='inspector-close-btn') works correctly to dismiss inspector
SVG overlay elements (polygons for strain, circles for clusters) render on heatmaps
Overlay positions correspond to structure coordinates from API response
